nodes.label: CaixaConfirmacaoComponent (app-caixa-confirmacao)
nodes.rationale: Text via content projection so it can carry emphasis or links; obrigatorio only shows asterisk and does not validate (use Validators.requiredTrue). Value is boolean.

nodes.label: CampoDocumentoComponent (app-campo-documento)
nodes.rationale: One file per field (value File|null); accept only filters the native dialog, FormControl validator must reject other formats; no hardcoded Portuguese text beyond defaults so labels are passed translated.

nodes.label: formatarTamanho(bytes)
nodes.rationale: Exported so file size shown elsewhere (e.g. application review) uses the same format.

nodes.label: DropdownMenuComponent (app-dropdown-menu)
nodes.rationale: Two item patterns (config array and template directive) usable together; variante 'escuro' is the institutional navigation skin used by the site header.

nodes.label: criarErrosFormulario (erros-formulario.ts)
nodes.rationale: With OnPush, a getErro() function keeps the same reference so the internal computed never re-evaluates; pass a string derived from a signal instead.

nodes.label: FormFieldInputComponentV2 (form-input-field)
nodes.rationale: Resolves erro via computed against parent FormGroup from ControlContainer; known limitations: inline unused, setDisabledState does not apply to native element.

nodes.label: FormFieldSelectComponent (field-select / field-select-v2)
nodes.rationale: Icon type auto-detected from string pattern (URL/extension = image, else Material Icon); optionTemplate delegates all item rendering.

nodes.label: AlertModalService
nodes.rationale: open(options) is the recommended API; modal(options) kept as alias for backward compatibility. template takes priority over mensagem.

nodes.label: ModalDataService
nodes.rationale: Injects data into the template component; obterDados<T>() gives type-safety; data is cleared automatically on close.
